comparison: Advertised competent human-delivered services for a bounded single-file CSV cleanup; no AI superiority prerequisite

observed_vs_assumed.observed: Public indexed provider advertisements, supplied scope and listed fees, including lower-priced offers
observed_vs_assumed.unobserved: Transactions, actual competent human delivery quality/time, provider use of AI, customer adoption, and actual complete AGI ALPHA cost
observed_vs_assumed.modeled: Matched-scope applicability, seller costs, residual review, buyer preference, recurrence, collections and reinvestment

references.scope: One CSV <=10000 rows; whitespace/headings, exact duplicates, missing/invalid values, quality report and one revision
references.fit: Lower-price simple-service anchor; richer version reconciliation is not specifically quoted

references.scope: Starter single CSV cleanup, duplicate/blanks report, reproducible Python, original preserved, one revision
references.fit: Close low-price anchor; exact row bounds not retrieved; no claim this is a transaction or matched custom quote

references.scope: Standard one UTF8 CSV <=10000 rows/100columns/10MiB, agreed rules, clean/duplicates/exceptions/quality report, source sample review, one revision
references.fit: Most detailed output match; professional sample review/support must be costed; this study implements five fixed columns and <=256 characters/cell

scope_policy: Same input file and explicit cleanup rules, exact integrity, one scoped revision and a usable complete packet; no fuzzy matching, enrichment, contextual advice or Excel workbook work. Necessary reviewer/support attention is an explicit cost sensitivity, not silently removed.
selection_policy: Report every price and discount cell. These references are not a representative market distribution, mean, median or observed willingness-to-pay. Do not privilege a profitable upper anchor.
discovery_revisions: AROTIP $299 broader package was screened but not selected as sole benchmark after cheaper same-family services were located.

A provisional 20/49/99 panel was replaced BEFORE confirmation by 20/25/99: Khalil's $49 tier covers <=500 records whereas the primary panel uses 800-1600. The $49 listing remains in evidence, not in the primary economic grid.
human_production_tools: Human providers may use ordinary Python/Excel/PowerQuery. Human-only/no-AI authorship is not verified. The study compares human-delivered service prices, not manual character editing or every competing AI offering.
stopping: Freeze before market outcomes; no price/workload/acceptance adjustment after confirmation. New scenarios require a separately labeled exploratory revision.
